zh: 第 i 天的两部分都包含第 i 天：前缀是第 1..i 天之和，后缀是第 i..n 天之和；后缀可以用总和减去前 i−1 天之和得到。
答案就是所有“到当天为止的前缀和”与“从当天开始的后缀和”中的最大值，一次扫描就能同时得到两者。
先求总和 total；prefix=0；对每天的 v：先用 total−prefix（从当天开始的后缀）更新答案，再 prefix+=v，并用 prefix（到当天为止的前缀）更新答案。答案可能为负，初值要取极小值；用 64 位。
en: Both parts for day i include day i: the prefix is the sum of days 1..i and the suffix the sum of days i..n; the suffix equals the total minus the sum of the first i-1 days.
The answer is simply the maximum over all prefixes ending at some day and all suffixes starting at some day, and one scan yields both.

Compute total first; prefix = 0; for each day's v: update the answer with total - prefix (the suffix starting today), then prefix += v and update the answer with prefix (the prefix ending today). The answer can be negative, so start from a very small value; use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the total first, then maintain the prefix day by day. The current suffix is the total minus the previous prefix; compare both the current prefix and that suffix.

## Proof of correctness

When the loop reaches day i, the previous prefix is exactly the sum of days 1..i-1, so the total minus it is the suffix that includes day i; adding the current change gives the prefix that includes day i. Every day is checked, so all valid candidates are covered with nothing missed or repeated.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n) including the input, O(1) auxiliary.
